extDescription.message: Tells you if a Brazilian site is a scam, and why.

summary_baixo_risco.message: No risk signals in the checks below.

summary_atencao.message: A few signals deserve attention before you continue.

summary_alto_risco.message: Several strong scam signals on this site.

summary_nao_verificado.message: No check returned any data. That does not mean the site is safe.

reason_blocklist.message: This site is on a known-scam list.

reason_pix_personal.message: The payment goes to a person, not the company.

reason_pix_wrong_cnpj.message: The payment goes to a different company than the one on the site.

reason_cnpj_inactive.message: The company's tax ID is not active.

reason_no_cnpj.message: The site shows no tax ID — normal for sites that don't sell directly.

reason_no_cnpj_with_payment.message: The site asks for a Pix payment but won't say which company receives it.

reason_cnpj_active.message: Tax ID active with the federal revenue service.

reason_domain_new.message: This site was created only days ago.

reason_brand_lookalike.message: The address looks like it's imitating a known brand.

reason_cnae_mismatch.message: The company is registered under a different business activity.

reason_registrant_mismatch.message: The site is registered under a different name.

reason_contact_only_whatsapp.message: The only contact is WhatsApp or a free email address.

reason_cheap_tld_private_whois.message: This kind of address (.shop, .xyz) is common in scams.

reason_broken_social_links.message: The social media links don't work.

reason_tranco_top100k.message: This site gets a lot of traffic.

reason_domain_established.message: Domain registered more than five years ago.

reason_domain_mature.message: Domain registered more than two years ago.

reason_marketplace_notice.message: This analysis covers the seller, not the marketplace itself.

footer_disclaimer.message: This is an automated analysis. When in doubt, don't pay.

popup_no_page.message: Open a site to see the analysis.
